tagline: Weather app with geolocation, API integration, and secure serverless handling

details.overview: A weather application that fetches real-time data using OpenWeatherMap API with geolocation support and secure API handling using serverless functions.
key_features: City search with stored search history
Secure API key handling via serverless functions
Dynamic UI updates based on weather conditions
what_i_learned: Working with REST APIs and real-time data fetching
Handling user input and search functionality
Securing API keys using serverless functions
